mapper.insert: insert into im_chat_message (session_id, user_id, role, content, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, session_id, user_id, role, content, create_time, remark from im_chat_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by create_time asc, id asc
select count(1) from im_chat_message where session_id = #{sessionId}
select id, session_id, user_id, role, content, create_time, remark from im_chat_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
